lines: Down Home For Dinner...It echoes sweet memories from my
childhood. It could he a warm breesy spring or summer
Sunday-anxious to head "down" to Grandma & Grandpa
Strom's house to play "mother may I?"
with "dozens of cousins" out in the front yard. Or, it could be
a cool, rainy fall Sunday or a snowy, blustery winter Sunday
or holiday-in Grandma & Grandpa's cozy house filled with
warmth, noise and lots of laughter and happiness, as the kids
entertained themselves with "button, button, who's got the
hutton? "or us girls "adorning" ourselves with the fascinating
jewelry from Grandma's wonderful jewelry box she would let
us play with! And who could forget all the great food, and lots
of it. that always covered the kitchen table and countertops! 1
know we all have fond memories of the family get-togethers,
and with this collection of recipes, memories and photos, may
it take us back for a while, as we remember, with fondness,
